example:
import { CenteredShell, EditorialSection, EditorialSectionHead } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<CenteredShell preset="public-landing" flow="sections" topbar={<SiteHeader />} footer={<SiteFooter />}>
  <EditorialSection tone="subtle" divider="both" spacing="section" aria-labelledby="sets">
    <EditorialSectionHead titleId="sets" title="Every expansion, a new chapter." />
  </EditorialSection>
</CenteredShell>
name: EditorialSection

props.description: Band content, already in the landing column.
props.name: children

props.description: Ground: page canvas, card surface, muted, or the hero wash.
props.name: tone

props.description: Landmark name reference (the section head's titleId).
props.name: aria-labelledby

tagline: One full-width band of an editorial page (gh#1435): put it straight inside `CenteredShell preset="public-landing" flow="sections"`. Its ground (`tone`) and block hairlines (`divider`) run edge to edge while its content sits in the landing column (max width + gutter). `spacing="section"` pads it by the section rhythm. Geometry: `--editorial-section-*`.
usage: DO stack bands directly in a `flow="sections"` shell — the shell drops its column cap, gap and main padding for them.
DO NOT nest a band inside a capped column: it cannot reach the edges there.
